column1: # How the voice says Hindi words that espeak gets wrong.
# written<TAB>spoken. The spoken form is only for the voice; the plan, the
# timing and the film keep the written word. One word stays one word.
# Every line is checked against espeak by tests/test_hindi.py.
# f and z sounds: the nukta (फ़, ज़). Without it espeak says ph and j.
# A vowel espeak adds between consonants: a halant removes it.
